$comment: Envelope stand-in for the 'catalog.json' that server_to_client.json and common_types.json reference (v0.9 and v0.9.1). web_core validates protocol message envelopes against it, so they are checked independently of any particular catalog; component properties and themes are validated against the surface's catalog afterwards (validation/payload-validator.ts). Components are only required to be objects here: updateComponents may partially update a component the surface already holds, and the processor reports a missing or invalid 'id' itself.
title: A2UI v0.9 envelope catalog
